metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 program in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It accepts `--input` and `--output`, inspects LAS files into the requested JSON dataset, and renders datasets back to LAS using only the Node.js standard library.

I verified the supplied example through a render and inspect round trip. I also checked that a malformed point format returns `invalid_document` with exit code 1.
